what: The overall length of a standard-length hook in each size, eye to bend. The gauge draws every hook at one scale from these, so their ratios are what the drawing shows.
source: The reference design's gauge (plan/design/src/reference.src.html, LEN), as Shaun saw it at the design review. Shaun checks the drawing against the Mustad chart (ticket 35's HITL line): put his lengths here, set the status to checked, run node scripts/hook-gauge/generate.mjs, and commit both files.
